newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thais assure foreign creditors of ailing firms.
newsitem.headline: Thais assure foreign creditors of ailing firms.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Wednesday issued a circular to foreign creditors of 16 troubled finance companies assuring protection of their loans granted to those firms, a senior central bank official said on Wednesday.

"The governor issued a circular today to foreign creditors of 16 finance companies. The central bank wants to assure them about the protection of their loans," Thirachai Phuvanatnaranubala, director of the bank's Financial Institutions Supervision and Development Department, told reporters.
Last month authorities forced 16 ailing finance firms to stop operations and to come up with plans to merge or consolidate with other strong finance firms.

At the time the authorities assured depositors of the 16 closed firms that they would receive all of their money, but it had made no clear statement about the protection of those firms' creditors, especially foreign ones.
